name: pricing-plans
title: Pricing Plans
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: Choose one of a few fixed plans, then confirm. `PricingPlans` lays out the options and an optional `summary` (an `OrderSummary` with the chosen plan and a "Continue" action: sticky card on large screens, bar fixed to the bottom on smaller ones). `PricingPeriod` is the billing period as a segmented toggle that always has one selected (`value`/`onChange`, `PricingPeriodOption` with an `id`, a `Badge` inside for the saving). `PricingPlanGroup` is a radio group of `PricingPlan` cards, stacked in one list on small screens and side by side in equal columns once its own width fits them; each card has `name`, `badge` ("Most popular"), `description`, `price` and `period` formatted by the app, `priceNote` (the equivalent, "R$ 718,80 per year") and `isFeatured` for a `primary` border, with the radio named by the plan and described by its price. `PricingPlanFeature` lists what the plan has (`isIncluded={false}` for a dash, muted text and "Not included" read before it). For a plan built from quantities and add-ons, use `plan-builder`. Built-in text is in English; translate it with `i18n.labels`.
